The '''Sendoth Ruins''' was a series of ancient structures that lay in ruins by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Located atop [[Mount Sendoth]] in the [[Glarus Valley]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the ruins were the site of the [[Alderaan Peace Summit]] between the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]].
